'''Jonathan Brown'''<ref name="dt-20313">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/20313 Bringing the Beats  (cough) before me], DeckTech (Jonathan "Carny" brown, 30 December 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/20313/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/20313/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261016212138/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/20313/ Wayback Machine].</ref> (DeckTech handle '''Carny''') posted a [[Dark]] [[Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place|Bring Him Before Me]] list on DeckTech in December 2001.
